prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Document summary (ideology-neutral, no names)

- Core position: Leave the European Union and related legal frameworks, replace EU-derived rules with UK law, and redirect net contributions and regulatory savings to domestic priorities. Hold binding national and local referendums.

- Tax, spending, finance:
  - Raise the personal allowance to £11,500; introduce a single 31% flat rate merging income tax and employee NI; phase out employers’ NI over five years; abolish inheritance tax when finances allow.
  - Cut quangos and reduce the public sector to late-1990s size; replace VAT with a Local Sales Tax sharing revenue with councils; return a share of business rates locally.
  - Restore Bank of England oversight; raise bank capital ratios; separate retail and investment banking; reinstate lending controls.

- Jobs, enterprise, skills:
  - Long-term investment programmes in defence procurement, nuclear power, flood/coastal protection, transport, and prisons to boost manufacturing.
  - Create Production Enterprise Centres for SME support.
  - Replace university/FE funding with student/training vouchers; make institutions independent charities.
  - Tighten takeover rules for strategic sectors.

- Immigration and asylum:
  - Five-year freeze on settlement; thereafter a capped, points-based system; time-limited work permits; visas for non-work visitors with health insurance; criminalize overstaying; triple border staffing; no amnesty for illegal residents.
  - Citizenship after at least five years’ permanent residence, with tests and declarations.
  - Hold asylum applicants in secure centres; require claims in the first safe country.

- Law and order:
  - Elected county police boards; longer, enforceable sentences; more prison capacity; “three strikes” for repeat offenders; stronger self-defence protections; end participation in the European Arrest Warrant; youth “boot camps.”

- Defence:
  - Significant budget increase; expand the Army and reserves; rebuild naval and air capabilities; maintain and renew the nuclear deterrent; prioritize NATO; reassess operations abroad; reduce defence bureaucracy; improve service conditions.

- Health:
  - Protect frontline NHS services; reduce management layers; elected county health boards; franchise service provision on fixed budgets; health vouchers for opting out; restore matrons and on-the-job nurse training; free eye tests and dental check-ups.

- Education:
  - School vouchers; literacy/numeracy focus with early testing; retain and expand selective/specialist options via a broader aptitude test; strengthen discipline and teacher training; end social engineering in university admissions; convert some universities to vocational colleges; elected education boards; franchise providers; support special schools and home education.

- Pensions and welfare:
  - Universal, non-means-tested citizen’s pension (~£130/week at 65+); redirect pension tax relief toward low/mid earners; reinstate dividend tax credit; freeze unfunded public sector schemes; simplify benefits into a Basic Cash Benefit; allow work without losing benefits up to the personal allowance; consolidate child and nursery support; restrict benefits to citizens or 5+ years’ residents; introduce workfare.

- Trade and foreign affairs:
  - Replace EU political union with a trade-based relationship; regain an independent WTO role; seek Commonwealth and other bloc trade deals; support democratic self-determination.

- Energy and environment:
  - Expand nuclear to about half of electricity; support cleaner coal; prioritize offshore wind only if market-funded; repeal climate targets and carbon trading; establish an independent climate review; shift funds to practical environmental improvements; electrify transport; invest in flood defences.

- Transport:
  - Extra infrastructure investment; road upgrades; fuel-duty stabilizer; local control over parking/cameras; charge foreign lorries; block very large lorries; three new high-speed rail lines; reopen lines; shift freight to rail/canals; improve port links; develop a Thames Estuary hub airport instead of expanding existing ones.

- Housing and planning:
  - Curb demand via immigration control; bring empty homes into use; scrap regional planning bodies; binding local referendums on major schemes; elected Green Belt managers; end Section 106/social housing mandates; local listing; scrap HIPs; enable council bonds for social housing; end empty property business rates.

- Governance:
  - Citizen-initiated binding referendums (5% threshold); adopt AV+; expand direct local elections; adjust devolution using existing MPs; English-only legislative days; right of recall; abolish regional government; enhance parliamentary war/treaty powers; review the second chamber.

- Culture:
  - Merit-based policies; protect key brands and traditional measures; curriculum on national contributions; limit face coverings in specified settings; deport preachers who incite violence; update treason law; ensure faith-school materials align with national law; create a Commonwealth Day and centre; establish an English Parliament; new English public holiday.

- Farming and fishing:
  - Leave EU farm and fisheries regimes; maintain farm support short term while promoting domestic produce and clear labels (including GM and ethical standards); enable producer co-ops; supermarket ombudsman; allow county votes on hunting.
  - Reclaim a 200‑mile EEZ; end quotas and discards; require all catches landed; create movable no‑take zones; ban industrial and pair trawling; strengthen fishery protection.

- Other:
  - Stronger animal welfare; protect Royal Mail and Post Offices; allow designated smoking rooms; cut burdens on SMEs.
